description: PROC-007 — the employee's own held dates after the payroll cut-off. Read-only here: the correction is made by reopening the week in My Timesheet and resubmitting it, which is what the functional owner described (10-Aug-2026). Distinct from main-salary-stopping, which is the MANAGER's view of who is held.

loaded.description: Separates 'nothing held' from 'not fetched yet'. Without it the empty state shows for a moment on every visit and reads as good news that has not been established.

holdADP.description: Page scope, so the array-linked binding is safe here — at APPLICATION scope it is evaluated during variable setup and leaves the ADP half-built.

daysLeft.description: Smallest days_left across the open rows. The banner counts down the tightest deadline, not an average.

windowClosed.description: Every held date is past its 60 days. The page still lists them — hiding them would leave someone whose pay is held with no explanation anywhere.
